about: The ledger of layer 1 of the mockup fidelity gate (test/ui-tokens.test.js). It is empty, and it stays empty: since m5-ui-port-cleanup, its gate, the test requires no token, no font and no literal entry, unconditionally. tokens: a token of app/renderer/tokens.css whose value the app used and the mockup's shared rules (app/renderer/ui) contradicted; fonts: a face the mockup's rules ask for that was not bundled; literals: colour and size literals per file that should name a token. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: every literal becomes a token and there is no allowlist; the mockup's token values win; JetBrains Mono Medium is bundled. m5-ui-tokens-spacing cleared the token entries and the literals of app/renderer/ui and of mockup.html, m5-ui-alignment-chrome the font entry, the component port features (m5-ui-port-*, decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-17) the literals of their files, and m5-ui-port-cleanup the last ones, of shell.css, with the app-only tokens of UI redesign 10.7 (4). Adding an entry needs the maintainer.
